title: Bar Netiza
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:3: his vat had been left uncovered, and he asked Rabbi Ba bar Mamal, etc. Hyman gives the following readings: in Terumot 8:3, Bar Netuza; in the Venice printing, Bar Yudani; and in the Ran on Avodah Zarah, section 1231, Bar Marna.

notes.text: The consulted edition of Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:3 has Bar Netuza in the account of the uncovered vat.
